## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2019-09-20: S-1 first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.6
- 2019-10-21: Up-C IPO closes; executed TRA dated October 21, 2019 filed as Exhibit 10.5 to the IPO 8-K

#### Up-C collapse and economic dormancy

- 2021-10-26: 8-K announces the transaction agreement collapsing the Up-C structure via Post distribution and merger
- 2022-03-10: Up-C collapse closes; SpinCo Tax Matters Agreement waives Article IV application and stipulates no Change of Control; $10.2M of the carrying liability reversed as a non-cash adjustment
- 2022-09-30: Residual TRA payable of $0.1M; subsequent annual 10-Ks (FY2023-FY2025) disclose no TRA liability

## Explanation

BellRing Brands completed its Up-C IPO on October 21, 2019 carved out from Post Holdings and executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with Post and future LLC members covering Section 754 basis step-ups on Post's LLC unit redemptions, Section 704(c) disproportionate allocations, and imputed-interest deductions. On March 10, 2022, BellRing closed an Up-C collapse via a Post spin-off and merger; the SpinCo Tax Matters Agreement waived Article IV (early termination) application to the transaction and stipulated that the collapse was not a Change of Control. The contract was not amended or terminated, but most of the carrying liability was reversed as no new tax benefits accrue under it post-collapse; subsequent annual reports disclose no recognized TRA liability. The TRA legally remains in force for any residual pre-2022 attributes. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
